author: daeron
summary: Continue Thyris ADB userspace on Linux KVM: AUTO_INSTALL=force then disk-boot SRC=/thyris with hidden VGA plus serial file, allow guest reboot, inject adbd USB/TCP default.prop. PhoneVMState.READY only after real adb shell. Disk-create stays ISOConverter._create_disk. ISOLINUX installer boot remains a non-READY proof.

thyris.provenance: snapshots/v0.15/manifest.json domains.thyris plus official android-x86_64-9.0-r2.iso live kernel/initrd. No prompt_bridge. No second qemu-img owner.

edits.author: daeron
edits.summary: Hidden VGA+serial disk-boot without -no-reboot; initrd default.prop starts adbd on TCP 5555; host_command/guest_response on adb shell health. READY still only after the guest echoes thyris_adb_health.
